About this Event

🎃 BOLLYWEEN 2026: DC's Ultimate Bollywood Halloween Costume Party!

🎃DC's craziest Halloween tradition is back! Join us at THRōW Social DC for Bollyween Night—the ultimate fusion of spooky season and high-energy South Asian nightlife.
We are turning up the heat with upscale vibes, premium production, and an unforgettable crowd. Whether you are coming for the music, the costumes, or the VIP treatment, this is the one Halloween party you cannot afford to miss.

🎧 THE SOUNDTRACK
Headlining the night is DJ Sarthak, Philly’s #1 Bollywood club DJ! Expect a seamless, high-energy mix of your favorite tracks all night long:
Vibrant Bollywood & Tollywood bangersHeavy Punjabi anthems & Bhangra remixesOpen-format club classics and tech-house mashups✨ THE EXPERIENCE & WHAT TO EXPECT
Massive Costume Contest: Cash and surprises for the "Best Dressed" attendees.Upscale Vibes: Premium lighting, sound, and a camera-ready atmosphere.Free Parking: Hassle-free parking available on-site for all guests.VIP Bottle Service: Luxury table layouts for groups looking to level up their night.🎭 DRESS CODE: AMERICAN OR DESI COSTUMES
Go all out! Wear your best American or Desi Halloween costume. Whether you want to pull off full cinematic filmy drip, an elegant Desi look, or a classic spooky outfit—bring your main character energy.

🎟️ TICKETS & VIP TABLE RESERVATIONS
Ladies Special: The first 50 ladies enter FREEVIP Tables & Bottle Service: Elevate your night with premium seating. To reserve a table, call 717-602-4193 immediately (Tables sell out fast!).Don't wait until the week of Halloween. Grab your tickets, rally the group chat, and get ready to dance the night away!
